d: We are seeking talented and motivated UAE National Piping Engineers to join our Engineering and Projects team. This opportunity is open to fresh graduates as well as experienced professionals with up to 10 years of experience in Oil & Gas projects. The role would be based in Sharjah, UAE.
This recruitment activity supports the organization's Emiratization objectives and commitment to hiring UAE Nationals.
q: Internship experience in Oil & Gas, EPC, Energy, or Industrial projects is preferred
Experience with FEED, Detailed Engineering, Brownfield, Greenfield, or EPC projects is preferred.
Understanding of piping design principles and engineering practices.
Familiarity with ASME, ASTM, API, ANSI, and international codes and standards.
Knowledge of: P&IDs , Piping Material Specifications , Pipe Stress Analysis , Equipment Layouts , 3D Modeling ,Isometric Drawings ,Pipe Supports
r: Assist in the preparation of piping layouts, routing studies, and engineering drawings.
Support piping design activities in compliance with project specifications and industry standards.
Review P&IDs, piping layouts, isometrics, and 3D models.
Coordinate with multidisciplinary engineering teams including Mechanical, Process, Civil, Structural, Electrical, and Instrumentation disciplines.
Participate in site visits, inspections, and project meetings.
Assist in the preparation of technical documentation, reports, and material requisitions.
Support engineering calculations and design reviews.
Ensure compliance with HSE and quality requirements.
For Mid-Level and Senior Engineers (4-10 Years)
Perform piping design and engineering activities for onshore and offshore Oil & Gas projects.
Develop piping specifications, material requisitions, datasheets, and technical bid evaluations.
Conduct piping stress analysis and flexibility studies.
Review and approve piping layouts, isometrics, and plot plans.
Coordinate with clients, contractors, vendors, and project teams to ensure successful project execution.
Support constructability reviews, HAZOP studies, and design risk assessments.
Participate in procurement, installation, commissioning, and start-up activities.
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers.
Ensure compliance with project schedules, budgets, and quality standards.

We are seeking a passionate, energetic, and service-driven Server to join our award-winning steakhouse restaurant. The Server is responsible for delivering exceptional dining experiences by providing attentive, personalized, and professional service throughout every stage of the guest journey.
This role requires a deep commitment to hospitality excellence, menu knowledge, and the ability to create memorable experiences that exceed guest expectations.
q: Previous experience in a restaurant, hotel, resort, or hospitality environment preferred.
Fine dining or upscale restaurant experience is an advantage.
Passion for hospitality and delivering exceptional guest service.
Ability to work in a fast-paced and high-volume environment.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Strong problem-solving abilities and a guest-focused mindset.
Basic knowledge of food, beverages, wines, and service etiquette preferred.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and public holidays.
Good command of English; additional languages are an advantage.
Ability to stand and walk for extended periods and lift or carry restaurant equipment as required.
Positive attitude, reliability, and willingness to learn and grow within the organization.
r: Welcome guests in a warm, professional, and friendly manner.
Present menus, explain menu items, specials, and beverage offerings.
Provide knowledgeable food, wine, and beverage recommendations to enhance the dining experience.
Accurately take and enter guest orders into the POS system.
Serve food and beverages according to established service standards.
Anticipate guest needs and respond promptly to requests and concerns.
Ensure guest satisfaction throughout the dining experience and resolve minor issues professionally.
Maintain expert knowledge of menu items, ingredients, preparation methods, and allergens.
Prepare and set tables before service and maintain cleanliness of dining areas.
Complete opening, closing, and side-work duties as assigned.
Process guest payments accurately and handle cash and credit card transactions responsibly.
Follow all food safety, hygiene, health, and sanitation standards.
Collaborate effectively with kitchen and restaurant team members to ensure smooth operations.
Maintain a professional appearance and uphold the highest standards of hospitality at all times.
Support colleagues and contribute to a positive and productive team environment.
x: We offer a dynamic and professional work environment where employees are empowered to grow, develop their careers, and deliver exceptional hospitality experiences. Team members benefit from ongoing training, development opportunities, and the chance to work alongside passionate hospitality professionals dedicated to excellence.
Join our team and help create unforgettable dining experiences in one of the region's premier steakhouse destinations.
